messages:
:rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: spike in 5xx + streaming disconnects on /v1/stream (us-west-2). Error rate > 8% over last 2 min. Auto-pager sent to oncall. Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/streaming-live-mitigation

Jamie (oncall): i'm on it. seeing lots of `502` and `upstream prematurely closed connection` from gateway. can someone grab gateway logs?

Maria (platform): grabbing logs now, filtered by route `/v1/stream` and region us-west-2. Looks like chunked transfer frames from clients often end with `client aborted` within 200-400ms of first chunk. Also interleaved `504` from gateway to runtime.

Trent (runtime): seeing concurrent KV cache misses + long tail p99 latency at the runtime layer. Affected workers show repeated `internal: write: connection reset by peer` in model serving process. Might be backpressure causing the runtime to close connections.

Jamie (oncall): hypothesis: partial chunked frames trigger an internal stall in runtime batching, causing backpressure -> gateway times out -> client cancels -> connection closed.

Lisa (support): any visible customer impact numbers? a couple of customers reported truncated responses. CC'ing support tickets 13245,13246.

metrics-bot: metrics snapshot: total requests (2m window) = 134k, streaming requests = 21k, 5xx count = 11k (8.2%), streaming disconnects = 6.7% of streaming requests. p99 latency (streaming) increased from 420ms -> 1.8s.

Jamie (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable streaming->paged fallback for high-error clients, 2) reduce max concurrent batches per worker (cheap config change), 3) enable gateway request-level retries off for streaming routes, 4) route 10% traffic to last-known-good model variant. i'll run steps 1+3 now.

Maria (platform): flag in edge-config: `streaming_fallback: true` for route `/v1/stream`. pushing change to edge with TTL 30s. command: `edgectl set /v1/stream streaming_fallback=true --region us-west-2 --ttl 30s`

deploy-bot: edge config update queued by Maria. change applied to 12/12 edge nodes in us-west-2.

Trent (runtime): reducing `max_concurrent_batches` from 64 -> 32 on hot pools via runtime-config: `rtctl set --pool=hot max_concurrent_batches=32`. applying now.

Jamie (oncall): disabling automatic streaming-retries at gateway for this route to avoid compounding duplicates: `nginx: proxy_next_upstream off` (applied via edge).

metrics-bot: 60s after mitigation: streaming disconnects down from 6.7% -> 2.1%, overall 5xx 8.2% -> 3.9%. p99 back to 620ms.

Lisa (support): sending interim note to affected customers: "We're rolling a mitigation for streaming interruptions; temporary switch to paged responses may occur. We're tracking root cause and will update."

Jamie (oncall): i'm also opening a short-term circuit breaker: 90% pass-through to normal route, 10% to `model-v1.8-stable` via routing policy to reduce pressure on current model. command: `routectl set /v1/stream fallback_model=model-v1.8-stable --percent=10 --region=us-west-2`

Trent (runtime): logs show fewer `connection reset` after config change. but we still see one noisy worker with repeated `oom` events. i'll cordon that host and drain new sessions. `infractl cordon worker-9-usw2`

Maria (platform): cordon done, drain in progress. also toggled `enable_kv_prefetch=true` to reduce cold cache stalls.

metrics-bot: 5m after mitigations: 5xx steady at 1.8%, streaming disconnects at 0.9%.

Jamie (oncall): moving to monitoring mode. next steps for postmortem: - capture full request traces for 5% sample, - correlate client-side chunk sizes and timeout behavior, - reproduce locally with chunked-sse and artificial backpressure.

Trent (runtime): reproducer notes: using `curl -N -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" --data-binary @chunks.txt` we can mimic partial chunk bursts. I'll run isolated perf test with lowered batching to verify. code snippet: ```bash
# simulate partial chunking
python3 tools/send_chunks.py --rate 50 --chunksize 512 --duration 60 http://edge-usw2.internal/v1/stream
```

Lisa (support): ETA for customer-facing post? can draft a message after we confirm root cause.

Jamie (oncall): Estimated impact: ~12k streaming requests affected over 10m window, ~480 unique customer API keys, severity P2 (client-visible degraded streaming, short-lived). I'll create incident ticket INC-1995 and assign owners for RCA.

incident-bot: Incident INC-1995 created. Reminder: include timeline, mitigation commands, and customer impact counts in the postmortem.

Trent (runtime): quick action item: add defensive read-timeouts in runtime when parsing chunked frames to avoid infinite waits. i'll draft PR.

Maria (platform): follow-up: running job to backfill traces and compute exact SLO breach minutes. started job id `trace-backfill-1995`

Jamie (oncall): thanks team. marking oncall handover note — if anything regresses ping with :rotating_light: and i'll escalate to infra. otherwise i'll start doc and RCA tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Lisa (support): ping me when post is ready, i'll push to customers.

deploy-bot: canary rollback for `edge-config` not required. all mitigations remain in place.

Jamie (oncall): closing thread for now, monitoring window open for 1h. end of live mitigation.
